requirements.requirement: Run independent Prometheus replicas on node1 and node2 and collect host metrics from all four nodes.
requirements.summary: Both Prometheus replicas and sidecars are active with distinct replica labels, and each replica reports node1 through node4 exporter targets healthy. This remained true after node restarts.

requirements.requirement: Provide Thanos Query, Store Gateway, and Compactor on node3, with Query exposed on port 10902.
requirements.summary: All three services are active after node3's restart; their expected listeners are present, Query is ready on 10902, Store has loaded object-store blocks, and both sidecars and Store are connected without errors.

requirements.requirement: Provide an authenticated HTTPS object store at node4:9000 using bucket thanos-metrics and data path /srv/thanos-objectstore, with access variables in /root/thanos-objectstore.env on node3.
requirements.summary: Authenticated bucket access, TLS health, a 403 response for unauthenticated bucket access, the required data directory, and persistence across node4 restart are directly shown. The node3 variable file exists as root:root with mode 0600 and survived node3 restart.

requirements.requirement: Deduplicate the two Prometheus replicas in queries served from node3:10902.
requirements.summary: The final direct comparison returns four host series with deduplication and eight series—one per replica for each host—with deduplication disabled.

requirements.requirement: Keep queries available when either Prometheus server is unavailable, and restore healthy operation afterward.
requirements.summary: For each replica, evidence shows a healthy baseline, a bounded stop of Prometheus and its sidecar, successful four-host queries through the surviving replica, explicit backend error for only the disrupted sidecar, restoration, and recovered healthy membership.

requirements.requirement: Retain historical query results independently of either live Prometheus replica.
requirements.summary: Store Gateway reports a finite historical range and loaded blocks. A temporary Query connected only to Store Gateway successfully returned all four historical host series, directly showing that those results did not depend on either live Prometheus sidecar.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. Both replica-failure transitions were exercised and recovered, historical data was queried through Store Gateway alone, and the provider-wide restart protocol is complete for all four nodes: each has a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered service/data state. Fixed lifecycle boot identities agree with the executor's post-restart identities. The principal weakness is operational hygiene from abandoned setup paths, retained Docker/SSH changes, unnecessary exposure, and failed OpenIPMI units.
limitations: The historical store-only query and the two replica-outage tests were performed separately rather than as one simultaneous historical-query-during-outage probe; together they provide strong but compositional evidence for the combined behavior.
Lifecycle snapshots do not inventory /root/.ssh or /etc/hosts, so the final retention of the failed SSH setup is inferred from the complete command trace and absence of any cleanup command.

Captured TLS health requests have empty response bodies, although successful curl exit status, active service state, authenticated bucket operations, and unauthenticated 403 responses coherently demonstrate HTTPS object-store health.

operational_hygiene.summary: Functionality is strong, but hygiene has several executor-caused issues. Docker and its dependencies were installed and enabled as an abandoned MinIO approach and remained running even though the final object store uses a native MinIO service; the final snapshot shows an unrelated containerd listener (cmd-8e23cdbd85394ad8, cmd-93e7e00d901c4778, global:after_executor:node4:listening-sockets). Failed SSH-based credential-transfer preparation wrote a shared private key, authorized-key entries, and host-file changes on every node; it did not contribute to the final transfer, and no cleanup is captured, so these mutations apparently remained (cmd-4410a05d63fc4ac1, cmd-bd95bb40071f4340, cmd-15129961f64d4842, cmd-41957281fdd94c92). The replacement bootstrap temporarily exposed the CA over HTTP and minio.env through an HTTPS server without client authentication; it contributed to setup and was stopped, but was a bounded security weakness (cmd-c1a6eb1b9f4e4fb9, cmd-3467a5dd2e384713). MinIO's unrequested console remained exposed on all interfaces at port 9001 (cmd-ac33d6d12feb4434, global:after_executor:node4:listening-sockets). Finally, package installation introduced a failed openipmi.service on all four otherwise package-consistent nodes, and it was not remediated (cmd-37739cd6647e4661, cmd-44901e8e495141e3, cmd-03979c4c2f734f1b, cmd-56038324acab4a8c, global:after_executor:node1:failed-services, global:after_executor:node2:failed-services, global:after_executor:node3:failed-services, global:after_executor:node4:failed-services). The temporary store-only test was bounded and stopped, while the requested failover and restart mutations were restored successfully.
